The server side is TypeScript:

```typescript
export function fileLinkLabel(file: FilePathPosition, suffixByPath: ReadonlyMap<string, string>): string {
  const suffix = suffixByPath.get(file.path.replaceAll("\\", "/"));
  return [fileBasename(file.path), suffix, file.line ? `L${file.line}` : undefined]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" · ");
}
```
